title: 第八章 武市
content_zh:
走进武市，张若尘径直向中心拍卖场走去。
灵级下品的武技，不是那些一般的商铺能够吃得下，只有拿到中心拍卖场，拍卖给那些大家族，才能将武技的价值最大化。
张若尘刚刚走进拍卖场，一个穿着整洁容颜俏丽的侍女便迎了上来，看到张若尘的那一副神秘的装束，她丝毫都不觉得诧异，十分礼貌的道： “先生，你需要什么帮助？”
“我要见你们中心拍卖场的大执事！”张若尘稍微将自己的声音改变了一些，显得颇为沉浑，听上去就像是一个三、四十岁的中年人。
这到底是什么人啊？一开口就要见大执事，看来来头不小。
“奴婢现在就去禀告大执事，但是大执事一般都很忙，要接待贵宾客户，未必会有时间出来见你。你先稍等片刻！”
说完这话，那一个侍女便立即走进一扇大门，前去禀告大执事。
张若尘倒也不急，只是站在大堂中静静的等待。
没过多久，那一位侍女便带领着一位穿着华贵衣袍的微胖老者走了出来，指向张若尘的方向，道： “大执事，就是那人。”
大执事远远的向着穿着黑色斗篷衣的张若尘看了一眼，目光定格在张若尘的脚上，他那一双苍老的眼睛微微的一眯，闪过一丝精芒。
张若尘脚上穿的靴子，名叫 “麒麟镶金靴”，只有王宫中的人，才有资格穿这样的靴子。
张若尘自然是故意将自己的靴子露出，毕竟他要拍卖的是灵级下品的剑法，难免不会被人觊觎。以他现在的武道修为，根本保不住灵级下品的剑法。
但若是让人知道，他是宫里的大人物，那么还敢打他主意的人，估计就没有几个了。
在自己的实力不够强大的情况下，只能装出自己很有实力的样子，用来吓唬吓唬人，还是很有必要的。
“来头不简单啊！”
大执事看着张若尘脚下的那一双靴子，心中如此想到。
大执事对张若尘的态度立即变得恭敬起来，将张若尘当成了宫里的大人物，走到张若尘面前低声说道： “大人，这边请！”
“嗯！”
张若尘为了震慑住对方，背负着双手，表现出十足的气度，轻轻的点了点头。
大堂中的那些武者，看到大执事居然表现出这样的态度，心头都在暗暗猜测，看来中心拍卖场来了一位了不起的大人物。

登上中心拍卖场的第三层，张若尘四平八稳的坐在最上方，接过侍女递过来的茶杯，用着一种上位者的口吻说道： “我这里有一样宝贝，想要寄放到中心拍卖场拍卖，将你们最顶级的鉴定师叫过来，帮我鉴定一下。”
大执事看到张若尘的那一份气度，更加肯定对方是王宫里面的重要人物，立即命人去请鉴定师。
片刻之后，一位头发花白的老者走了进来。
老者，看上去七八十岁的样子，一双眼睛却炯炯有神，将张若尘看了一眼，发现自己竟然看不透对方的修为，心头不禁一惊。
老者立即恭敬的对着张若尘一拜， “老朽就是中心拍卖场的首席鉴定师，不知道大人要拍卖的东西在什么地方？”
看不透对方的修为，只有三种情况：第一种，对方的武道修为比他要高。
第二种，对方修炼的功法，比他修炼的功法高明很多。
比如，修炼人级功法的武者，一般便看不透修炼灵级功法的武者的修为，只能从对方的一些细节和展现出来的气息，大致猜测对方的修为。
当然，若是功法的级别相差不多，修为高的人，依旧能够看透修为低的人的武道修为。
第三种，对方的身上有
隐藏修为的宝物。
第二种和第三种情况并不常见，所以那一位老者本能的以为是第一种情况，以为张若尘的修为在他之上，所以才立即恭恭敬敬的对着张若尘行礼。
要知道张若尘修炼的可是《九天明帝经》，何等高深的功法，除非是他刻意将体内的经脉展现出来，要不然的话，整个云武郡国估计都没有几个人能够看透他的武道修为。
再说，张若尘的前世本来就是天极境大圆满的强者，虽然重生在一个普通人的身上，但是那一股对武道的理解和灵魂所携带的精气神，与天极境大圆满的武者并没有区别。
想要看透他的修为，除非对方的武道境界在天极境大圆满之上。
张若尘的手伸进衣袖，在时空晶石上面一摸，手掌直接进入时空晶石的内空间，将《天心剑法》的口诀取出来，递给那一个头发花白的老者。
“我要拍卖的就是这一卷灵级下品的剑法！”张若尘淡淡的道。
首席鉴定师刚刚接过 “天心剑法”的口诀，就听到张若尘的话，心头微微一惊。竟然要拍卖灵级下品的剑法！
首席鉴定师立即将卷在一起的纸张展开，仔细研究起来。
站在一旁的大执事，也立即走过去，一起查阅那一份 “天心剑法”的口诀。

首席鉴定师和大执事都是武道高手，很快就鉴定出结果，同时点了点头。
“的确是灵级下品的剑法的口诀，不知道大人的手中掌握了多少招剑招？”大执事问道。
口诀和剑招配合在一起，才能发挥出灵级下品剑法的真正威力。
就算大执事和首席鉴定师强行将 “天心剑法”的口诀记下来，若是没有与之相配合的剑招，那么记下来的口诀就没有任何用处。
张若尘道： “整套剑法，一共十二招。剑法的最初本已经遗失，我手中掌握的 “天心剑法”是由一位天极境的强者亲手画出的剑招图式，与剑法的最初本，并没有任何区别。”
首席鉴定师沉思了片刻，道： “既然如此，那就给 “天心剑法”的起拍价定为二十万枚银币。但是有一个前提，拍卖成功之后，买主要对 “天心剑法”的剑招和口诀进行检阅，若是检阅出并不是灵级下品的剑法，拍卖结果便不做数。”篳趣閣
张若尘点了点头，道： “一切都按拍卖场的规矩办！”
“天心剑法”的拍卖，就在今天晚上，成为中心拍卖场今晚的压轴物品。
在拍卖场开始之前，中心拍卖场便立即将消息传给了王城中的各大家族。
各大家族的重要人物，纷纷携带巨资赶到武市，都想将那一套完整的灵级下品剑法拍买到手。
张若尘并不关心拍卖过程，只关心拍卖的结果。
大概两个时辰过去，拍卖会结束，拍卖的结果也出来了。
在各大家族的争夺中， “天心剑法”的价格被抬高到一百二十四万枚银币，最终被林家的家主夺到手。
“居然是林家！”张若尘听到这个结果之后也微微诧异了一下。
没过多久，在大执事的带领下，林家家主林奉先，林家的一位族叔林德，还有云武郡国四大年轻美人之一的林泞姗，从外面走了进来。
“林家主，这位大人，就是‘天心剑法"的主人。”大执事的脸上带着笑意，向着坐在最上方的张若尘指过去，
林奉先的目光在张若尘脚上的那一双 “麒麟镶金靴”上面停留了片刻，轻轻的点了点头，微微拱手，道： “在下林家家主林奉先，不知大人如何称呼？”
在进来之前，林奉先就听大执事描述过这个神秘人，知道对方大有来头，很可能是王宫里面的大人物。
所以，林奉先走进来后，才主动放低自己林家家主的姿态。
见到林奉先和林泞姗，张若尘便更加小心起来，以防被他们认出。

张若尘干咳了两声，声音变得沉浑： “你们无需知道我的名讳。这是‘天心剑法"的口诀和剑招图式，林家主拿过去检阅一番吧！”
说话间，张若尘从衣袖中将口诀和剑招图式取出来，放到了桌上。
林奉先并没有检阅 “天心剑法”的口诀，他相信，中心拍卖场在拍卖之前，就已经鉴定过口诀。
他将 “天心剑法”的剑招图式展开，只见纸张上面刻画着十二幅小人图。
若是普通人看那十二幅图，根本看不出任何特殊之处，但是当林奉先的目光落在纸张上面，那十二个手持长剑的小人就像是活过来了一般，站在纸张上舞动剑法。
每一招剑法都精妙绝伦，蕴含着博大精深的武道意境，哪怕只是学会其中一招，就已经受用无穷。
“这一套剑法在灵级下品的武技中绝对属于顶尖级别，简直买得太值了！”林奉先的心头无比激动。
content_en:
Entering Wu City, Zhang Ruochen walked directly to the central auction house.
Low-level spirit-level martial arts are not something that ordinary shops can afford. Only by taking them to the central auction house and auctioning them to those big families can the value of the martial arts be maximized.
As soon as Zhang Ruochen entered the auction house, a neatly dressed and pretty maid came up to him. Seeing Zhang Ruochen's mysterious attire, she was not surprised at all and said very politely: "Sir, what help do you need?"
"I want to see the chief deacon of your central auction house!" Zhang Ruochen changed his voice slightly, making it appear quite deep. He sounded like a middle-aged man in his thirties or forties.
Who is this? He wanted to see the Archdeacon as soon as he opened his mouth. It seemed that he had a lot of background.
"Slave, please go report it to the Archdeacon now, but the Archdeacon is usually very busy and has to receive VIP customers, so he may not have time to come out to see you. Just wait a moment!"
After saying this, the maid immediately walked into a door and went to report to the chief deacon.
Zhang Ruochen was not in a hurry, he just stood in the lobby and waited quietly.
Not long after, the maid led a fat old man in luxurious robes out, pointed in the direction of Zhang Ruochen, and said, "The Archdeacon is that person."
The Archdeacon glanced at Zhang Ruochen, who was wearing a black cloak, from a distance, and his eyes were fixed on Zhang Ruochen's feet. His old eyes narrowed slightly, and there was a glimmer of light.
The boots Zhang Ruochen wore were called "Kirin-Inlaid Gold Boots." Only people in the royal palace were qualified to wear such boots.
Zhang Ruochen naturally exposed his boots on purpose. After all, what he was auctioning was a low-level spiritual swordsmanship, so it was inevitable that it would not be coveted. With his current level of martial arts cultivation, there is no way he can maintain his low-grade swordsmanship at the spiritual level.
But if people knew that he was a big shot in the palace, then there would probably be very few people who would dare to take action against him.
When one's own strength is not strong enough, it is necessary to pretend that one is very strong in order to scare others.
"The background is not simple!"
The Archdeacon thought as he looked at the pair of boots under Zhang Ruochen's feet.
The chief deacon's attitude toward Zhang Ruochen immediately became respectful, and he regarded Zhang Ruochen as a big shot in the palace. He walked up to Zhang Ruochen and whispered, "Sir, please come this way!"
"Yeah!"
In order to intimidate the other party, Zhang Ruochen put his hands behind his back, showed full magnanimity, and nodded gently.
The warriors in the lobby, seeing the Archdeacon showing such an attitude, were secretly guessing that a great figure had come to the central auction house.
After ascending to the third floor of the central auction house, Zhang Ruochen sat calmly at the top. He took the teacup handed by the maid and said in a superior tone: "I have a treasure here that I want to put in the central auction house for auction. Call your top appraiser over and help me appraise it."
Seeing Zhang Ruochen's magnanimity, the chief deacon was even more sure that Zhang Ruochen was an important figure in the palace, and immediately ordered someone to hire an appraiser.
After a while, an old man with gray hair walked in.
The old man looked like he was seventy or eighty years old, but his eyes were sparkling. He glanced at Zhang Ruochen and found that he couldn't see through the other person's cultivation level, and he couldn't help but be surprised.
The old man immediately bowed respectfully to Zhang Ruochen, "I am the chief appraiser of the central auction house. I wonder where the things you want to auction are?"
There are only three situations in which one cannot see through the opponent's cultivation level: First, the opponent's martial arts cultivation level is higher than his.
The second type is that the technique practiced by the other party is much better than the technique practiced by him.
For example, warriors who practice human-level techniques generally cannot see through the cultivation of warriors who practice spiritual-level techniques. They can only learn from some details of the opponent.The aura displayed by Jiehe roughly guessed the opponent's cultivation level.
Of course, if the levels of the skills are similar, a person with a high level of cultivation can still see through the martial arts level of a person with a low level of cultivation.
The third type is that the other party has
A treasure that hides cultivation.
The second and third situations were not common, so the old man instinctively thought it was the first situation and that Zhang Ruochen's cultivation level was higher than his, so he immediately saluted Zhang Ruochen respectfully.
You must know that Zhang Ruochen practiced the "Nine Heavens Ming Emperor Sutra", such a profound skill, unless he deliberately showed the meridians in his body, otherwise, there are probably not many people in the entire Yunwu County who can see through his martial arts cultivation.
Besides, Zhang Ruochen was originally a strong man in the Great Perfection of the Heavenly Realm in his previous life. Although he was reborn in the body of an ordinary person, his understanding of martial arts and the spirit carried by his soul were no different from those of a perfect warrior in the Great Perfection of the Heavenly Realm.
If you want to see through his cultivation level, unless the opponent's martial arts realm is above the Great Perfection of Tianji Realm.
Zhang Ruochen put his hand into his sleeve and touched the space-time crystal. His palm directly entered the inner space of the space-time crystal. He took out the formula of "Tianxin Sword Art" and handed it to the gray-haired old man.
"What I want to auction is this volume of low-level spiritual swordsmanship!" Zhang Ruochen said calmly.
The chief appraiser had just received the "Tianxin Sword Technique" formula when he heard Zhang Ruochen's words and was slightly shocked. They actually want to auction low-level spiritual swordsmanship!
The chief appraiser immediately unfolded the rolled papers and studied them carefully.
The great deacon who was standing aside immediately walked over and looked up the "Tianxin Sword Technique" formula together.
The chief appraiser and the archdeacon were both martial arts masters. They quickly identified the results and nodded at the same time.
"It is indeed a formula for low-grade swordsmanship at the spiritual level. I wonder how many sword moves you have mastered in your hands?" the Archdeacon asked.
The combination of formulas and sword moves can bring out the true power of low-level spiritual swordsmanship.
Even if the Archdeacon and the Chief Appraiser forcefully write down the formula for "Tianxin Sword Technique", if there are no sword moves to match it, then the written formula will be of no use.
Zhang Ruochen said: "The entire set of sword techniques, a total of twelve moves. The original copy of the sword technique has been lost. The "Tianxin Sword Technique" I have in my hand is a sword move pattern drawn by a strong man in the Tianji Realm. There is no difference from the original sword technique."
The chief appraiser pondered for a moment and said: "In this case, let's set the starting price of "Tianxin Sword Technique" at 200,000 silver coins. But there is a premise. After the auction is successful, the buyer will review the sword moves and formulas of "Tianxin Sword Technique". If the review reveals that it is not a low-grade sword technique at the spiritual level, the auction result will not be counted." Junqu Pavilion
Zhang Ruochen nodded and said, "Everything must be done according to the rules of the auction house!"
The auction of "Tianxin Sword Technique" will be held tonight and will become the grand finale of the central auction house tonight.
Before the auction started, the central auction house immediately spread the news to all the major families in the royal city.
Important figures from major families rushed to the martial arts market with huge sums of money, all wanting to buy the complete set of low-grade spiritual swordsmanship.
Zhang Ruochen didn't care about the auction process, only the results.
About two hours later, the auction ended and the results of the auction came out.
In the competition among the major families, the price of "Tianxin Sword Technique" was raised to 1.24 million silver coins, and was finally seized by the head of the Lin family.
"It's actually the Lin family!" Zhang Ruochen was slightly surprised after hearing this result.
Not long after, under the leadership of the chief deacon, Lin Fengxian, the head of the Lin family, Lin De, an uncle of the Lin family, and Lin Ningshan, one of the four young beauties in Yunwu County, walked in from outside.
"The Lin familyLord, this sir is the master of the ‘Tianxin Sword Technique’.” With a smile on his face, the great deacon pointed towards Zhang Ruochen, who was sitting at the top.
Lin Fengxian's eyes lingered for a moment on the pair of "Kirin-inlaid gold boots" on Zhang Ruochen's feet. He nodded slightly, cupped his hands slightly and said, "I'm Lin Fengxian, the head of the Lin family. What do you call me?"
Before coming in, Lin Fengxian heard the Archdeacon describe this mysterious man and knew that he had a strong background and was probably a big shot in the palace.
Therefore, after Lin Feng first walked in, he took the initiative to lower his status as the head of the Lin family.
Seeing Lin Fengxian and Lin Nishan, Zhang Ruochen became even more careful to avoid being recognized by them.
Zhang Ruochen coughed twice and his voice became thicker: "You don't need to know my name. This is the formula and sword move pattern of the 'Tianxin Sword Technique'. Master Lin, take it over and review it!" "
While talking, Zhang Ruochen took out the mantra and sword move patterns from his sleeves and put them on the table.
Lin Fengxian did not review the formula of "Tianxin Sword Art". He believed that the central auction house had already appraised the formula before the auction.
He unfolded the sword move pattern of "Tianxin Sword Technique" and saw twelve little figures carved on the paper.
If ordinary people looked at the twelve pictures, they wouldn't see anything special at all. But when Lin Fengxian's eyes fell on the paper, the twelve little people holding long swords seemed to come alive, standing on the paper and dancing with sword skills.
Every sword move is exquisite and contains a profound and profound artistic conception of martial arts. Even if you only learn one of the moves, you will have endless benefits.
"This set of swordsmanship is definitely at the top level among low-level spiritual martial arts, and it's worth buying! "Lin Fengxian was extremely excited.
